baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call, comparative proximity, and the paired relational nouns in 22:13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling draws a target into an intimate support position, while mawla and ashir name protection and sustained company. The comparative reverses those roles: the relation gives harm first access and leaves benefit relatively remote, so the doubled blame condemns a harmful architecture of attachment rather than mere nonresponse.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing by speech supplies the act that establishes attachment to the target.
Loss and bad condition opposed to benefit supplies the adverse output of the relation.
Physical or meaningful nearness makes access, not merely quantity, the comparison being made.
Benefit as assistance toward good supplies the support that the invoked relation should have delivered.
Loving alliance and aid supplies the expected protective function that is inverted.
Close mixing and companionship makes the harmful target an ongoing associate rather than a remote object.

changed_reading.before: A person petitions an ineffective being.
changed_reading.after: A person installs a supposed protector-companion in the nearest relational channel, and that channel routes harm before benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call in 22:13 followed by mawla and ashir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can perform a claim of right or affiliation, while the two closing nouns supply legal-social patronage and group belonging. The verse can therefore expose a chosen identity claim whose liabilities are closer than its protections: the caller does not only ask the target for something but names himself into its network.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right, lineage, or affiliation lets the invocation function as self-enrollment.
Kinship nearness supplies the social closeness claimed by the caller.
Kinship, emancipation, neighborhood, and alliance patronage supplies an institutional bond with reciprocal expectations.
A group sharing one affair supplies the collective identity into which the caller affiliates.

changed_reading.before: The invocation is a private request addressed outward.
changed_reading.after: The invocation is also a claim of belonging to a patronage group whose attached liabilities outrun its promised protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call's collapse branch, the sequence branch of wali, and the nearness of harm in 22:13.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of the call root pictures one part falling after another, while wali can mark uninterrupted succession. Together they make the harmful relation a cascade: attachment initiates a sequence in which each adjacent consequence follows the previous one, making harm 'nearer' as the first and repeatedly renewed arrival.

activation_trace.role: Successive collapse supplies the chain reaction latent in the act of calling.
Uninterrupted succession supplies the adjacency by which one harmful consequence follows another.
Nearness supplies the short interval between links in the cascade.
Damage and diminution supply the repeated output of the sequence.

changed_reading.before: One invocation has one bad consequence.
changed_reading.after: Entry into the invoked relation starts a tightly linked sequence in which harm repeatedly succeeds harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier alliance sequence makes the bad mawla operational rather than inert. One who takes this patron is misdirected and then guided to punishment, so the patron performs a real guidance function with a reversed destination. Harm is nearer because patronage itself becomes the delivery route.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and aid supplies the patronal role whose direction is being tested.
Harm supplies the destination reached through the inverted patronal channel.
Taking an ally supplies the initiating bond in the explicit causal sequence.
Deviation from the intended way supplies the first active effect of the patronage.
Guidance toward a route supplies the patron's effective but reversed directional work.

structural_cues: 22:4 places alliance before a linked misleading-and-guiding sequence whose stated endpoint is punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alliance, deviation, guidance, and the harmful endpoint; I infer that the false patron is the conduit joining them. A live alternative is that the sequence states consequences of allegiance without defining patronage itself as their efficient channel.

changed_reading.before: The bad patron is useless and fails to guide.
changed_reading.after: The bad patron is effective in the wrong direction: attachment guides the dependent toward the very harm from which a patron should protect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence frames worship as an edge-position tested by favorable and adverse events: reassurance under good reverses into turning and total loss under trial. The next ayah calls a substitute that is near but short of the goal and names the resulting error far away. The focus comparison then reads as a topology of misvaluation: accessibility is mistaken for benefit, while the accessible substitute brings harm into nearest reach.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the focus ayah's measure of access.
Assistance toward good supplies the value that mere accessibility fails to guarantee.
Inclination away from a direction supplies the unstable edge-position of the worshipper.
Turning a thing onto another face supplies the reversal triggered by trial.
General diminution supplies the total cost of the unstable bargain.
A near position short of the goal supplies the deceptively accessible substitute.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the actual displacement produced by that choice.

structural_cues: 22:11-12 move from outcome-conditioned worship through reversal and loss to calling a substitute, while placing near/short-of-goal language beside distant error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the edge, event-conditioned reversal, accessible substitute, and distant result; I infer a bargain in which the subject confuses availability with utility. A live alternative is that these are adjacent descriptions of a type rather than one continuous decision mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The comparison says only that the invoked target is more harmful than useful.
changed_reading.after: The comparison exposes a spatial error in practical judgment: the caller chooses what feels near and available, thereby making harm near and the intended goal distant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later ritual economy makes benefits publicly witnessed and joins provision to feeding the distressed poor. The same root that supplies the focus ayah's formal blame appears as lived distress, while another passage gives benefits an appointed term. This activates a social audit of mawla and ashir: a close relation is condemned when it does not circulate provision and instead leaves distress as its nearest social product.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing company supplies the social relation whose material effects can be audited.
The doubled formula of blame supplies the focus ayah's adverse verdict on patron and companion.
Plural benefits as aids toward good make utility concrete and publicly witnessable.
Distress and constrained living turn the blame root into the condition borne by a vulnerable person.
Feeding another supplies the transfer by which benefit becomes social support.
An appointed endpoint supplies a boundary on the duration of material benefits.

structural_cues: 22:28 pluralizes benefit, links it to provision, and ends with feeding the distressed poor; 22:33 explicitly bounds benefits by an appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witnessed benefits, feeding, distress, and bounded utility; I infer that patronage and companionship can be judged by whether benefit reaches dependents. A live alternative is that the ritual distribution scene supplies a contrastive ethic without directly specifying the social mechanics of 22:13.

changed_reading.before: Harm and benefit are private outcomes for the caller.
changed_reading.after: Harm and benefit are also distributive tests of association: the bad patron-companion produces or abandons distress instead of moving provision through the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later renders association as a multi-stage loss of support: a fall begins, an external agent snatches, wind takes over, and the subject descends. This sequence concretizes the focus call-root's successive-collapse branch. The bad attachment makes harm near not as a single blow but by handing the caller from one uncontrolled agency to the next.

activation_trace.role: One part falling after another supplies the latent cascade inside the focus call.
Association with God supplies the contextual condition that links the fall image to calling another.
A noisy, disordered fall supplies the cascade's initiating loss of support.
Rapid seizure supplies the next transfer of control after the fall.
Descent into a gulf supplies the cascade's deepening terminal motion.

structural_cues: 22:31 sequences association, fall, snatching, wind-borne descent, and a far destination without restoring agency between stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a successive fall image and a collapse branch under the focus root; I infer that the later image activates a chain-reaction reading of the call. A live alternative is that the fall metaphor illustrates association independently and need not feed back into the lexical behavior of 22:13.

changed_reading.before: The harmful call yields one adverse result.
changed_reading.after: The call initiates a cascade in which each loss of control exposes the caller to the next, so harm is continuously the nearest arriving event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proximity comparative can take a temporal branch. Elsewhere benefits last to an appointed term, people impatiently demand an outcome, and a wronging settlement receives respite before seizure. This changes 'nearer' into a latency claim: visible delay is not distance from consequence, and the target's utility may be term-limited while harm already has the shorter route to arrival.

activation_trace.role: Approaching time and the nearing completion of an event supplies a temporal sense for the comparative.
Utility supplies the apparently favorable outcome whose duration is tested.
Benefits present in time supply a concrete utility that can expire.
A fixed limit supplies the expiry horizon attached to those benefits.
Demanding acceleration supplies the human tendency to equate delay with remoteness.
Extended respite supplies an interval that can conceal an approaching outcome.
Taking possession supplies the outcome that arrives after the interval.

structural_cues: 22:33 gives benefits an endpoint; 22:47 challenges impatient time-reckoning; 22:48 orders respite, then seizure, then destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal proximity, expiring benefit, impatience, respite, and eventual taking; I infer a comparison of consequence latency. A live alternative is that aqrab compares likelihood or relational access rather than chronological arrival.

changed_reading.before: The target causes more harm than benefit in an undifferentiated balance.
changed_reading.after: The target's benefit has a limited horizon, while harm has the shorter arrival path even when respite makes it look delayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later call is first classified as lacking truth and productive stability, then tested at collective scale: the invoked parties cannot create, cannot recover what is taken, and end with both seeker and sought weak. The focus harm can therefore include dependency's relational effect: the caller's attempt to acquire a patron joins two incapable poles and reproduces weakness instead of pooling capacity.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing toward a target supplies the relation whose capacity is tested.
Aid and alliance supplies the expected capacity gain that fails.
Companionship supplies the joining of caller and target into one ineffective relation.
Inactivity and absence of useful work supplies the invoked target's functional vacancy.
Gathering dispersed parties into one supplies the scale-up test that still fails to create capacity.
Extracting something from danger or another's hand supplies the rescue function the invoked group cannot perform.
The contrary of strength supplies the shared final state of both sides of the relation.

structural_cues: 22:62 identifies what is called apart from God as false; 22:73 repeats the call, tests collective creation and recovery, and closes by pairing the weakness of seeker and sought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falsity, failed aggregation, failed rescue, and paired weakness; I infer that dependency not only reveals but can reproduce incapacity across the relation. A live alternative is that caller and target are independently weak and the call merely exposes their pre-existing states.

changed_reading.before: The invoked target is too weak to help the caller.
changed_reading.after: The invocation constructs a mutually weakening dependency: aggregation adds no capacity, rescue fails, and both patron-seeker and patron-sought are diminished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same call root later takes an explicit destination toward the Lord and is immediately characterized by straight guidance. This makes calling a directional social act rather than an intrinsically good or bad ritual. In the focus ayah the wrong destination lets speech draw the caller into harmful proximity; in the later imperative the destination aligns the call with a straight route.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the directional act whose target matters.
Meaningful nearness supplies the position produced by the direction of the call.
The imperative call toward an explicit destination supplies the positive directional counterpart.
Gentle indication toward the true way supplies the orientation joined to the positive call.
Straightness and balanced alignment supplies the stable route generated by the right destination.

structural_cues: 22:67 uses the same call root with an explicit destination and follows it with the assertion of straight guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated call root, a destination, and straight guidance; I infer that calling creates directional pull and inherits value from its destination. A live alternative is that calling upon and inviting toward are distinct constructions whose mechanisms should not be fully merged.

changed_reading.before: The focus call is simply a devotional action directed at the wrong object.
changed_reading.after: The focus call is a vector of recruitment: speech creates nearness to its destination, so a wrong destination makes harmful attachment the call's immediate product.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah endpoint supplies an exact positive counterformula to the focus verdict. Defense operates earlier; at the close, holding fast is followed by 'your mawla,' praise of the mawla, and praise of the helper. The focus's bad patron and bad companion are thus measured by concrete anti-harm functions: holding, defending, and helping. Ashir is not merely replaced by another title; companionship is exposed as bad when it lacks effective support.

activation_trace.role: The doubled grammatical blame supplies the negative formula reversed at the surah's close.
Protective alliance supplies the role whose quality is judged by action.
Companionship supplies the social closeness that must prove itself as support.
Removing a harmful thing supplies active defense as a patronal benchmark.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies the dependent's active attachment to reliable protection.
Repeated protective alliance supplies the positive counterpart to the focus mawla.
Praise with ni'ma supplies the explicit reversal of the focus ayah's blame.
Aid that makes the supported party prevail supplies the operative content of good patronage.

structural_cues: 22:38 makes defense operative; 22:78 closes with hold-fast, your mawla, good mawla, and good helper, reversing 22:13's doubled blame pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defense, holding, the repeated mawla, reversed evaluation, and help; I infer that these actions define the relational test applied in 22:13. A live alternative is that the closing formula is a broad doxological contrast rather than an exhaustive lexical definition of every mawla or ashir.

changed_reading.before: The verse denounces a generically bad patron and companion.
changed_reading.after: The verse conducts a role audit: a patron-companion is bad precisely where attachment fails to hold, defend, and help, while the true counterpart performs all three.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary mapping of the focus call root to root_000477 and imports a violent-push image into a surface ordinarily anchored in calling. It remains packet-authorized and coheres with compulsion under harm and governance under mawla, but downstream prose should label it a form-distant pressure model rather than a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the focus call, the necessity branch of harm, and the governance branch of mawla.

activation_trace.role: A violent shove or rebuff supplies pressure driving the subject into the appeal.
Necessity and being forced toward what is disliked supplies the caller's constrained condition.
Taking charge and governing an affair supplies the harmful authority controlling the available route.

changed_reading.before: The caller freely chooses a harmful patron.
changed_reading.after: The caller may also be pictured as pressure-driven into reliance on an authority whose control makes harmful necessity reproduce itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material branch of wali as an under-saddle support rather than the ordinary personal patron. It remains anchored by mawla and gains a coherent whole-surah support-and-fall mechanism from holding the sky and holding fast, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for patronal function.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mawla in 22:13 read through its material underlay branch, with harm as the consequence of failed support.

activation_trace.role: The layer placed beneath a saddle supplies a load-bearing interface between dependent and pressure.
Damage supplies what reaches the dependent when the interface fails.
Holding and restraining supplies the positive structural act that prevents collapse.
Falling and coming to rest supplies the failure mode that holding averts.
A strap or fastening used for holding supplies the dependent's secure connection to support.

changed_reading.before: Mawla denotes only a personal protector.
changed_reading.after: Mawla can be explored as a load-bearing support interface: the good one holds the attached dependent against collapse, while the bad one places injury immediately under the load.

strongest_changes: The false mawla does not merely fail: 22:4 makes allegiance an active guidance channel whose destination is harm.
The immediate near/far sequence turns the focus comparison into a critique of mistaking an accessible substitute for useful proximity.
22:73 changes isolated weakness into mutual incapacity: aggregation cannot create or rescue, and both seeker and sought end weak.
22:78 supplies the exact positive counterformula, making holding, defense, and help the functional benchmark for patronage and companionship.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence kept several mechanisms live at once: relational inversion, claimed affiliation, cascade, temporal latency, distributive benefit, directional calling, mutual incapacity, and a final protection benchmark. The strongest surprise was that the bad patron can be actively effective in routing harm rather than merely absent or inert.
remaining_uncertainties: The compact packet gives the focus construction but no explicit syntactic adjudication, so the precise force of its lamed phrase remains open.
The temporal reading of comparative nearness competes with likelihood, accessibility, and relational proximity.
The coercive split-root and load-bearing readings are deliberately branch-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
